as_blocker_resolution: Range-Construction is correct on the combinatorics, Multiway is correct on the structural backdrop, and the combinatorial effect wins on net. First-principles combo count of villain's turn-RAISE range on Jc7s5d2h: VALUE combos that REQUIRE the As are AsJh/AsJd/AsJc (TPTK with nut-spade redraw, the canonical protection-raise hand on a two-tone-ish board — note AsJs is impossible since hero holds As and Js is not on board, board is Jc) plus AsAh/AsAd/AsAc (overpair AA) = ~6 value combos directly removed. BLUFF combos that REQUIRE the As are AsXs nut-flush-draw semi-bluffs with overcard equity (AsQs, AsTs, As9s realistically in CO's opening range, As8s/As6s much rarer) = ~3 bluff combos removed. Net the As blocks roughly 2:1 in favor of value-removal. Multiway's counter-claim that 'the As blocker removes the only bluff-raise candidates' is structurally wrong because (i) it ignores AJ-with-nut-blocker as the largest protection-raise value class on this board texture, and (ii) it conflates 'few bluffs exist in MW BET_RAISE' (true) with 'the As specifically cuts those bluffs more than the value' (false). The Multiway structural point — that bluff DENSITY in the raise range is already low — is correct and is the reason confidence stays MEDIUM not HIGH, but it does not flip the blocker math. Range-Construction has the cleaner combinatorial proof, even if the prose slightly overweights AsTs/As9s as protective-raise value (those are NFD semi-bluffs, not value). The net effect is unambiguously favorable to CALL.

FOLD HIGH is too strong; FOLD as a mix branch (~25-35%) is defensible, HIGH confidence is not.

critique_of_sonnet_majority: Sonnet split 3 FOLD / 2 CALL with the three FOLD votes (labellers 1, 2, 4) all making the same critical error: they read the board Jc7s5d2h as containing 'one spade' that gives hero only a backdoor or no flush draw. The board is rainbow (clubs/spades/diamonds/hearts — wait, 7s IS a spade), so hero with AsKs DOES have the nut flush draw (As + Ks + 7s on board = need one more spade by river = 9 outs). Labeller 4 explicitly writes 'AK-high with no pair, no FD' — this is a board-reading error that invalidates the FOLD verdicts. Labeller 1 says 'no flush draw (only As is spade, board has 7s — needs runner-runner spades)' — also miscounted; As + 7s + one more spade = flush, not runner-runner. Labeller 2 says 'board has no spades' — flatly wrong. The two CALL labellers (3 and 5) correctly identify the NFD and reach the right verdict. The majority FOLD is an artifact of suit-counting errors, not a substantive GTO disagreement. The CALL minority is correct.

revised_reasoning: After Round 1 cross-examination the verdict holds: CALL, MEDIUM, with the CALL/FOLD mix sliding marginally from 75/25 to ~65/35 to reflect Multiway's valid point about MW structural bluff suppression. The As-blocker disagreement resolves in favor of Range-Construction: on a turn BET_RAISE line on Jc7s5d2h, the As removes ~6 value combos (AsJh/AsJd/AsJc TPTK protection-raises + AsAh/AsAd/AsAc overpair) versus ~3 bluff combos (AsQs/AsTs/As9s nut-FD overcard semi-bluffs). The net 2:1 value-removal is unambiguous from combinatorics. Multiway's claim that 'As-blocker hurts hero by removing the only bluff candidates' inverts the count by ignoring the largest blocked class (AsJx). Multiway is correct that overall bluff DENSITY in MW BET_RAISE is structurally low, but that lowers the baseline bluff count symmetrically — it does not change the directional sign of the As-blocker effect, which remains favorable to CALL. Equity reckoning: NFD ~19.6% one-card to river + ~3-4% clean overcard outs (A/K dirty vs sets but clean vs AJ/KJ which is a meaningful value slice) = ~23% raw. Pot odds 18 into 46 = 39% required direct. The 16% gap is bridged by (a) implied odds on spade rivers — villain's set-heavy and AJ-heavy value range stacks off vs hero's check-raise or jam on the nut flush, conservatively +8-10% effective; (b) the As-blocker net value removal effect adding ~2-3% to villain's bluff share of raise range; (c) post-raise the original bettor between hero and raiser is squeezed and folds, collapsing the spot to effective-HU realization ~0.9 not the 0.75 Multiway estimates for true MW. Combined effective equity vs raiser's BET_RAISE turn range lands at 33-36% — short of 39% direct but comfortably above when the implied tail is added. RAISE is dominated (no fold equity vs a committed raiser whose range is 65%+ pure value even after blocker adjustments; turns AsKs into a 35%-equity bluff-jam). FOLD is the closest alternative and survives as the ~35% mix branch for population reads where villain's BET_RAISE turn line is set-pure. CALL is the GTO mainline; the As-blocker resolves favorably; confidence MEDIUM.
